reviews.title: Great deal for $635
reviews.comment: The OLED colors and 500hz are exactly what I was looking for. This is definitely the best monitor for your buck. Although this is my first OLED monitor, I have no complaints. Perfect for playing my comp games while also being able to watching youtube videos with high quality. Even the speakers sound really good even watching shows with my gf.

reviews.author: Rainey

reviews.title: Excellent monitor for the price
reviews.comment:
This thing is fantastic. 500hz with OLED picture quality is pretty insane. When this monitor is priced in the mid-600 dollar range (which it usually is), there simply isn't a better value on the market. Like most new monitors, it took a little dialing in to get the colors looking good, but after about 5 to 10 minutes of color and brightness tuning, the image on this panel is outstanding.
All of that said though, this isn't for everyone. You need beefy specs to push a screen like this (I'm using a 9800X3D with a 7900 XTX), and obviously you need to have games in your library that can reliably hit 400+ fps for this panel to make sense. But if you do have games that can hit those kinds of framerates (and contrary to the belief of some people, there are many games out there that can), then I'd say go for it, because this is a crazy good value for everything it offers. It's very likely the best monitor you can get for $600.

reviews.title: Great for the price, but probably not the best
reviews.comment:
This panel is amazing, the picture clarity coming from lcd to oled is beautiful. The 0.3ms pixel response time feels incredible as well as 500hz. Only downside is build quality seems not too great. The monitor came with some gaps between the panel and the edge of the plastic shell. However the base is solid metal and sturdy. Will add an update over time with any burn in if I experience it.
PS this panel only comes with a 1 year burn in warranty, take that as you wish. (Competitors offer 3 year warranties)
